Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Dick Johnson <d...@dlep1.itg.ti.com> wrote:
>I just opened my first box of Vampire boosters last night.
>.............not good..............
>Many of the booster packs had zero rares....There were 28 rares in 36 packs.

First, you should make sure that you have a correct checklist, and that you
actually didn't get rares in those 8 packs. Second, if you were really
shorted, you should be able to send in the boosters for replacements
(contact cust...@wizards.com).

>And 14 of the rares were political cards:
>7 Praxis Seizures, 5 Justicars, 2 others.
>In total......there were 87 political cards in the box.
>Are we being told that political actions are the future?

No, you just got a weird spike is all.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
